focus_areas: Connectivity of chain links (are they truly interlocked?)
Consistency of metal reflections across silver and gold parts
Boundary sharpness between the necklace and the patterned shirt
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the topology of the chain links. AI often generates overlapping circles that look like links but aren't physically connected. Also, check if the pendant hangs naturally from the last bead/link or if it seems to float/fuse with the chain.
image_description: A close-up shot of a silver-toned necklace worn by a person. The necklace features a chain composed of large, open circular links that transition into smaller spherical beads near the bottom. It terminates in a large, flat, circular pendant with a textured or hammered gold/brass finish. The wearer is dressed in a white top with red and blue graphic patterns.

expert_testimonies.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a necklace and not confused with other accessories like brooches or buttons.
To verify that the interlocking rings are topologically connected (linked) and not just overlapping visually, which is a common AI failure mode.
To analyze the consistency of specular highlights on the metal surfaces to ensure they match a single light source and material type.
